name: components-community-radial-nav
title: Radial Nav
blurb: Circular menu with animated pointer, items orbit at configurable distance.
description: Radial navigation showing menu items arranged in a circle around a central pointer. Pointer rotates toward active item with spring physics. Click items to activate.
use_when: Unique 360° navigation UX or control panels where circular layout fits the domain.
avoid_when: Standard linear navigation; radial menus surprise users and reduce scannability.
a11y: Menu items are keyboard-navigable and have aria-label. Root menu has aria-label. Pointer is aria-hidden.
